qa_pairs.question: What should you do to a joint if necessary during this procedure?
Which model year is specifically mentioned regarding the spot welded flange modification?
What must be done to the spot welded flange in the rear area of the wheel opening on cars beginning with 1988 models?
qa_pairs.answer: The spot welded flange in the rear area of the wheel opening must be crimped on cars beginning with 1988 models or when using wider tires.

qa_pairs.question: What should you do if necessary when working with the opposite side?
qa_pairs.answer: Compare with opposite side if necessary.

qa_pairs.question: When is crimping of the rear wheel opening flange required?
qa_pairs.answer: On cars beginning with 1988 models or when using wider tires.

qa_pairs.question: What visual components are shown in the middle diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The diagram shows the wheel opening area with a spot welded flange that needs to be crimped, labeled as part number 30 41 739.
